items.title: Medtronic (MDT) Won FDA Clearance For Hugo In 3.5 Million US Surgeries
items.summary: Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) received FDA clearance for its Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system for general surgery procedures in the U.S. The authorization expands Hugo's approved use beyond urologic surgery to a broader range of abdominal and soft-tissue operations. General surgery represents roughly 3.5 million procedures each year in the U.S., sharply widening Hugo's potential procedure pool. FDA clearance for Hugo in general surgery only tells part of the story of Medtronic's robotics push...
